title: 圆管与硅片束流测试结构
source_text: Synthetic beam test: world is a 400 x 400 x 400 mm G4_AIR box. An aluminium tube (G4_Al), inner radius 20 mm, outer radius 22 mm, full length 100 mm, is placed in world at (0,0,0) mm with z axis. A silicon box (G4_Si), full dimensions 10 x 10 x 1 mm, is placed in world at (0,0,0) mm inside the bore. No rotations, fields, optical surfaces or readout requested.
